new.en: When a project’s notes grow past their size, the AI tidies them as it finishes a task, and Memory marks a note that names a file that is gone.
new.pt-BR: Quando as anotações de um projeto passam do tamanho combinado, a IA organiza tudo ao terminar uma tarefa, e a Memória marca a anotação que cita um arquivo que sumiu.
new.es: Cuando las notas de un proyecto superan su tamaño, la IA las ordena al terminar una tarea, y Memoria marca la nota que nombra un archivo que ya no está.
new.fr: Quand les notes d’un projet dépassent leur taille, l’IA les range en finissant une tâche, et Mémoire signale la note qui cite un fichier disparu.
new.de: Wenn die Notizen eines Projekts zu groß werden, räumt die KI sie am Ende einer Aufgabe auf, und Gedächtnis markiert eine Notiz, die eine fehlende Datei nennt.

decisions: | R-next | 2026-10-22 | Own work method, slice 2: a note naming a gone file is judged when it is read (Memory, the start card), never written back as `(stale?)` into the project file. Writing it would change the words a kept decision's record is bound to, so the person's decision would read as an unreviewed proposal, and a file that comes back would need a second write to clear it. Only backticked project-relative paths whose last part has a known file extension are judged (`.js` only with a folder, since `Next.js` is a name). The card checks only the decisions it could show, so its cost stays near the 9 ms measured. | AI (Erick delegou) |
